page.overview:
What is Balbo Baggins?

Balbo Baggins was a hobbit of the Shire and the first recorded member of the Baggins family. He was the great-grandfather of Bilbo, great-great-grandfather of Frodo and great-great-great grandfather of Merry and Pippin.

Balbo Baggins married Berylla Boffin and had five children: Mungo, Pansy, Ponto, Largo, and Lily. Balbo was the first recorded Baggins in the Shire, and the ancestor of the Baggins family of Hobbiton.

On Balbo's dates: In the published Baggins genealogy only Balbo's birthdate is shown, but by looking at his children it is possible to estimate his date of death.
